goal: Send a mail to rakeshkabir@gmail.com about eating too much gewar

steps.description: Send an email to Rakesh Kabir regarding excessive consumption of gewar.

tool_args.subject: Health Concern: Excessive Gewar Consumption
tool_args.body:
Hi Rakesh,

I am writing to express some concern regarding your recent diet. It has come to my attention that you have been consuming a significant amount of gewar (cluster beans). While it is a nutritious vegetable, consuming it in such large quantities can lead to digestive discomfort and other health issues.

Please consider diversifying your vegetable intake to ensure a more balanced diet. Let me know if you would like me to help you plan some alternative meal options.

Best regards,
Taskmaster Agent
